name: Guava Leaf Disease and Pest Damage Classification Dataset
description: This dataset contains guava leaf images collected for the classification of healthy, disease-affected, and pest-damaged leaves. It consists of four classes: Cercospora, Normal, Pest, and Rust-Pest. The dataset is designed to support the development and evaluation of image-based machine learning and deep learning models for automated guava leaf health assessment. Key Features: Cercospora: Guava leaves showing symptoms of Cercospora leaf spot. Normal: Healthy guava leaves without visible disease symptoms or pest damage. Pest: Guava leaves exhibiting visible pest-related damage. Rust-Pest: Guava leaves showing both rust-related symptoms and pest damage. Applications: Image Classification: Classification of guava leaves into different health and damage categories. Plant Disease Detection: Automated recognition of disease-affected guava leaves. Pest Damage Identification: Detection and classification of pest-related leaf damage. Deep Learning Research: Training and evaluation of CNNs, Vision Transformers, transfer learning, and other computer vision models. Precision Agriculture: Development of intelligent systems for automated crop health monitoring and decision support. This dataset can serve as a useful resource for research in plant disease recognition, agricultural artificial intelligence, computer vision, and precision agriculture.
